# Cato Paus Skrede (@CatoPaus)

> Independent programmer & systems builder exploring new AI tools, native C++ performance, and bare-metal home servers in TypeScript, Python, C++ N-API, Firebase Genkit & Google Gemini.

## Flagship Repositories
- [open-knowledge-studio](https://github.com/CatoPaus/open-knowledge-studio): Turns sprawling AI research into organized, fact-checked knowledge graphs (OKF v0.2) and offline interactive workspaces (A2UI v1.0) built with Interpretable Context Methodology (ICM) on the Google AI Interactions API and Gemini 4 Argon (TypeScript, 0 runtime npm dependencies).
- [genkit-turboquant-embedder](https://github.com/CatoPaus/genkit-turboquant-embedder): Experimental Firebase Genkit middleware performing 1-bit Polar Quantization of Float32 embeddings via a native C++ N-API binary, reducing vector RAM by 96.8% with Next.js Turbopack compatibility (TypeScript, C++ N-API).
- [Antigravity-Agent-Mesh](https://github.com/CatoPaus/Antigravity-Agent-Mesh): Turns two used Dell Precision T7610 workstations into a 4-socket, 64-thread, 192 GB ECC home compute mesh for Google Antigravity 2.0 with NUMA-pinned ACP subagents, live Git worktree sync, S5 Wake-on-LAN, and Interstellar-inspired TARS/CASE voices (Shell, Linux).

## Ecosystem & Home-Lab Utilities
- [antigravity.google](https://github.com/CatoPaus/antigravity.google): Portable version checker and automated updater for the Google Antigravity 2.0 suite on Ubuntu and Debian (Shell).
- [unifi-google-nest-hub](https://github.com/CatoPaus/unifi-google-nest-hub): Self-hosted WebRTC bridge for streaming UniFi Protect security cameras onto Google Nest Hub displays with sub-second latency.
- [node-banana-genkit](https://github.com/CatoPaus/node-banana-genkit): Node-based visual workflow editor built around Firebase Genkit pipelines (TypeScript).
- [genkit](https://github.com/CatoPaus/genkit): Fork and experimentation sandbox for Google's open-source Firebase Genkit AI framework (TypeScript).

## Core Principles
- Zero-runtime-dependency AI engineering (TypeScript stdlib & clean native bindings)
- File-backed agent epistemics (Interpretable Context Methodology / ICM)
- Close-to-silicon performance: C++ N-API vector quantization and bare-metal NUMA compute orchestration
